grid.factor_status: not applied: the factor rebuilt without each sensor did not predict that sensor (spatial skill r = -0.237, threshold 0.3). The map shows CAMS alone and the register lists measured sensor locations instead of modelled neighbourhoods.

validation.method: Leave-one-sensor-out: each sensor's local factor is rebuilt from the other sensors only, then the fused hourly estimate (CAMS × factor) is compared with that sensor's screened hourly medians.

reference.source: EEA Air Quality Download Service, dataset 1 (E2a up-to-date, not yet verified)
reference.note: EEA metadata gives no coordinates for these Bulgarian stations, so the model is compared at the city centre and the sensors as a city-wide daily median. Station times are converted from the reported UTC+01 time zone. E2a data are provisional (not yet verified by the reporting country).

traffic_signal.note: CAMS NO2 at the city centre, 07–09 local. A city-wide pattern at ~11 km, not a street-level measurement.

model.background: CAMS European air quality ensemble via Open-Meteo, 0.1° lattice, bilinear interpolation
model.local_factor: exp(median log((sensor+1)/(CAMS+1)) per sensor minus the city median), Gaussian kernel σ=1500 m, shrunk towards 1 where fewer than 5 sensors lie within 2000 m; exactly 1 (CAMS only) below 3. The factor keeps the CAMS city-wide level and only redistributes it in space.
model.hotspot_score: 60% rank of long-term mean PM2.5, 25% rank of WHO 24-h exceedance days, 15% sensitive sites within 500 m (capped at 10); sensor-informed cells only

sources.cams: CAMS European air quality forecasts (ENSEMBLE), Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service, via Open-Meteo Air Quality API
sources.cams_note: Open-Meteo documents its CAMS Europe series as forecasts from October 2023 and the CAMS European reanalysis before; both are model output.
sources.weather: ERA5 via Open-Meteo archive API (10 m wind, relative humidity)
sources.reference: EEA Air Quality Download Service, dataset 1 (E2a up-to-date, not yet verified)
sources.satellite: Not used: Sentinel-5P NO2 granules on the Planetary Computer are about 66 MB each; a multi-month regional mean would need over 1 GB of downloads and a NetCDF stack, beyond this prototype's budget.
